chatShare.snapshotWarning: Anyone with the link can read and copy this fixed conversation snapshot. Review the full preview for private information. It includes readable user and assistant text, not tools or attachments, and does not update with later messages. Revocation cannot erase copies already saved.
chatShare.interactiveWarning: Invite one trusted person with full control of this chat: view, prompt, upload, stop or steer the agent, send queued messages now, manage the queue, change model/settings and permissions, manage goals, and create, edit or delete scheduled jobs. They can use the agent’s existing tools and context, including file access. No direct terminal, file browser/download, other chats, or server administration. This is not a tool sandbox. Revoking access does not undo accepted work or scheduled jobs.
